description: Use when a city, region or island name has to be turned into a place_id (needed by search_hotels, get_hotel_facts and get_price_guide): returns up to 5 matching places with place_id and country. A misspelled name returns the likely places; the match field says whether a place is exact, partial or fuzzy. If several fit, choose by country or ask the user.

language.description: The user's language: de, en or tr (default en).

query.description: City, region or island name, in any language.

name: find_place
title: Find a destination
